# 2 Kings Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 229v–231r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_009_page_001.jpg, 2KI_009_page_002.jpg, 2KI_009_page_003.jpg, 2KI_009_page_004.jpg

---

**9:1** And-Elisha the-prophet called to-one of-the-sons of-the-prophets [beney ha-nevi'im] and-said to-him: Gird [chagor] your-loins [motnekha] and-take this-flask [pakh] of-oil in-your-hand and-go to-Ramot Gilead.

**9:2** And-you-shall-come there and-see there Yehu son of-Yehoshafat son of-Nimshi, and-go and-raise-him [vahagimoato] from-the-midst of-his-brothers and-bring-him [to an] inner-room [cheder be-chader].

**9:3** And-take the-flask of-oil and-pour [veyatsaqta] on his-head and-say: Thus says YHWH: I-have-anointed-you [meshachtikha] king over-Yisra'el. And-open the-door and-flee [ve-nasta], and-do-not wait [lo techakkeh].

**9:4** And-went the-young-man [ha-na'ar], the-young-prophet [ha-na'ar ha-navi], to-Ramot Gilead.

**9:5** And-he-came, and-behold, the-commanders of-the-army [sarey ha-chayil] were-sitting. And-he-said: I-have a-word [davar] to-you, the-commander [ha-sar]. And-said Yehu: To-which of-all of-us? And-he-said: To-you, the-commander.

**9:6** And-he-rose and-came into-the-house, and-he-poured the-oil on his-head and-said to-him: Thus says YHWH, God of-Yisra'el: I-have-anointed-you king over the-people of-YHWH, over Yisra'el.

**9:7** And-you-shall-strike the-house of-Ach'av your-master, and-I-will-avenge [veniqamti] the-blood [demey] of-my-servants the-prophets and-the-blood of-all the-servants of-YHWH from-the-hand of-Izevel.

**9:8** And-shall-perish [ve'avad] all the-house of-Ach'av, and-I-will-cut-off [vehikhrati] from-Ach'av [those who] urinate against-the-wall [mashtin be-qir], and-restrained [atsur] and-freed [azuv] in-Yisra'el.

**9:9** And-I-will-make the-house of-Ach'av like-the-house of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, and-like-the-house of-Ba'sha son of-Achiyah.

**9:10** And-Izevel the-dogs [ha-kelavim] shall-eat in-the-plot [chelqat] of-Yizre'el, and-there-is-no-one [eyn] burying [qover]. And-he-opened the-door and-fled.

**9:11** And-Yehu went-out to the-servants of-his-master, and-one-said to-him: Is-[all] well [ha-shalom]? Why did-this madman [ha-meshugga'] come to-you? And-he-said to-them: You know the-man and his-talk [sicho].

**9:12** And-they-said: A-lie [sheqer]! Tell-us [haggidah], please. And-he-said: Thus and-thus he-said to-me, saying: Thus says YHWH: I-have-anointed-you king over-Yisra'el.

**9:13** And-they-hurried [vayemaharu] and-each-man took his-garment and-placed [it] under-him on the-bare [gerem] steps [ha-ma'alot] and-blew [vayitqu'] the-shofar and-said: Yehu has-become-king [malakh Yehu]!

**9:14** And-conspired [vayitqasher] Yehu son of-Yehoshafat son of-Nimshi against Yoram. And-Yoram was-guarding [hayah shomer] Ramot Gilead, he and-all Yisra'el, from-before [mippeney] Chaza'el king of-Aram.

**9:15** And-had-returned Yehoram the-king to-heal [lehitrape'] in-Yizre'el from the-wounds which the-Arameans struck-him when-he-fought with Chaza'el king of-Aram. And-said Yehu: If it-is your-desire [nafshekhem], let-no-one escape [paliyt] go-out from the-city to-go to-tell in-Yizre'el.

**9:16** And-rode Yehu and-went to-Yizre'el, for Yoram was-lying-down [shokhev] there. And-Achazyahu king of-Yehudah had-come-down to-see Yoram.

**9:17** And-the-watchman [ha-tsofeh] was-standing on the-tower [ha-migdal] in-Yizre'el, and-he-saw the-company [shif'at] of-Yehu as-he-came and-said: I-see a-company [shif'ah]. And-said Yehoram: Take a-horseman [rakkav] and-send to-meet-them and-let-him-say: Is-[there] peace [ha-shalom]?

**9:18** And-went the-rider of-the-horse [rokhev ha-sus] to-meet-him and-said: Thus says the-king: Is-[there] peace [ha-shalom]? And-said Yehu: What [is] to-you and-peace [mah lekha ule-shalom]? Turn [sov] behind-me. And-the-watchman told, saying: The-messenger came to-them and-did-not return.

**9:19** And-he-sent a-second rider of-a-horse [rokhev sus sheni], and-he-came to-them and-said: Thus says the-king: Is-[there] peace [shalom]? And-said Yehu: What [is] to-you and-peace? Turn behind-me.

**9:20** And-the-watchman told, saying: He-came to-them and-did-not return. And-the-driving [ha-minhag] [is] like-the-driving of-Yehu son of-Nimshi, for he-drives [yinhag] in-madness [be-shigga'on].

**9:21** And-said Yehoram: Harness [esor]! And-was-harnessed his-chariot. And-went-out Yehoram king of-Yisra'el and-Achazyahu king of-Yehudah, each in-his-chariot, and-they-went-out to-meet Yehu and-found-him in-the-plot [chelqat] of-Navot the-Yizre'eliy.

**9:22** And-it-was when-Yehoram saw Yehu, and-he-said: Is-[there] peace [ha-shalom], Yehu? And-he-said: What peace [mah ha-shalom], while the-harlotries [zenunei] of-Izevel your-mother and-her-sorceries [kheshafeyha] [are] many [rabbim]?

**9:23** And-turned Yehoram his-hands [yadav] and-fled, and-said to-Achazyahu: Treachery [mirmah], Achazyahu!

**9:24** And-Yehu filled [mille'] his-hand with-the-bow and-struck Yehoram between his-arms [zeroyotav], and-the-arrow went-out [vayetse'] from-his-heart [libbo], and-he-sank [vayikhray] in-his-chariot.

**9:25** And-he-said to-Bidqar his-officer [shalish]: Lift-him [sa'ehu] [and] throw-him [hashlekhehu] in-the-plot [chelqat] of-the-field of-Navot the-Yizre'eliy. For remember [zekhor], [when] I and-you were-riding [rokhevim] pairs [tsemedim] after Ach'av his-father, and-YHWH lifted upon-him this oracle [ha-massa']:

**9:26** Surely [im lo] the-blood [demey] of-Navot and-the-blood of-his-sons I-saw yesterday [etmol], declares [ne'um] YHWH, and-I-will-repay-you [veshillamti lekha] in-this plot [chelqah], declares YHWH. And-now, lift-him [and] throw-him in-the-plot, according-to-the-word of-YHWH.

**9:27** And-Achazyahu king of-Yehudah saw, and-fled [vayanas] [by] the-way of-the-garden-house [derekh beyt ha-gan]. And-pursued after-him Yehu and-said: Also-him [gam oto], strike-him [hakkuhu]! In-the-chariot, at-the-ascent of-Gur which [is] near Yivle'am. And-he-fled to-Megiddo and-died there.

**9:28** And-carried-him his-servants in-a-chariot to-Yerushalayim and-buried-him in-his-tomb with-his-fathers in-the-city of-David.

**9:29** And-in-the-eleventh year of-Yoram son of-Ach'av, Achazyahu began-to-reign over-Yehudah.

**9:30** And-came Yehu to-Yizre'el, and-Izevel heard, and-she-put [vatashim] paint [pukh] on-her-eyes and-adorned [vateyitev] her-head, and-looked-down [vatashqef] through the-window [ba-chalon].

**9:31** And-Yehu came in-the-gate, and-she-said: Is-[there] peace [ha-shalom], Zimri, murderer of-his-master [horeig adonav]?

**9:32** And-he-lifted his-face to the-window and-said: Who [is] with-me? Who [mi mi]? And-looked-down to-him two [or] three eunuchs [sarisim].

**9:33** And-he-said: Throw-her-down [shimtuha]! And-they-threw-her-down [vayishmtuha], and-spattered [vayiz] from-her-blood on the-wall and-on the-horses, and-he-trampled-her [vayirmesenah].

**9:34** And-he-came and-ate and-drank, and-said: Attend [piqdu], please, to-this cursed-one [ha-arurah ha-zot] and-bury-her, for she-is a-king's daughter [bat melekh].

**9:35** And-they-went to-bury-her, and-they-found of-her nothing except the-skull [ha-gulgelet] and-the-feet [ha-raglayim] and-the-palms of-the-hands [kappot ha-yadayim].

**9:36** And-they-returned and-told-him, and-he-said: [This is] the-word of-YHWH which he-spoke by-the-hand of-his-servant Eliyahu the-Tishbiy, saying: In-the-plot of-Yizre'el the-dogs shall-eat the-flesh [besar] of-Izevel.

**9:37** And-the-corpse [nivlat] of-Izevel shall-be like-dung [ka-domen] on the-face of-the-field in-the-plot of-Yizre'el, so-that they-shall-not say: This [is] Izevel.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.8 — "those who urinate against the wall":** The Hebrew *mashtin be-qir* is a crude idiom for "every male." It appears in formulaic curse language (cf. 1 Sam 25:22, 1 Kgs 14:10). The phrase "restrained and freed" (*atsur ve-azuv*) is a merism meaning "absolutely everyone, without exception."

**v.11 — meshugga' (madman):** The officers call the young prophet *meshugga'* — the same word used for ecstatic prophetic behavior (cf. 1 Sam 19:24, Jer 29:26). It functions here as both mockery and recognition: prophets were known for wild, spirit-driven behavior. Jehu's deflection ("You know the man and his talk") maintains deniability.

**v.20 — "he drives in madness (shigga'on)":** Jehu's chariot driving is so furious it is recognizable from a distance. The word *shigga'on* (madness/frenzy) echoes the *meshugga'* label applied to the prophet in v.11. Madness brackets the chapter — prophetic madness and military madness.

**v.22 — "What peace?":** The Hebrew *mah ha-shalom* is a devastating refusal. The word *shalom* has been repeated ironically throughout the chapter (vv.17, 18, 19, 22, 31). Each time it is asked, peace is further away. Jehu redefines the question: there can be no *shalom* while Jezebel's influence persists.

**v.31 — "Zimri, murderer of his master":** Jezebel's taunt is historically precise: Zimri murdered King Elah and reigned only seven days before dying (1 Kgs 16:9-20). She is telling Jehu: your coup will end like Zimri's — in fire and death. Even facing death, Jezebel deploys language as a weapon.

**v.37 — "so that they shall not say: This is Jezebel":** The ultimate erasure — not only death but the obliteration of identity. There will be no tomb, no memorial, no monument. The dogs have consumed her so thoroughly that no one can point to remains and say "This was Jezebel."

*— EMET*
